description: Reports whether a Diagnostic is queued, running, completed or failed, by its id (diagnostic_id, as start_diagnostic and list_diagnostics give it), with when it started and how many minutes have passed. A Diagnostic usually takes 5 to 10 minutes; one taking longer is reported as running with slow set, because it may still finish, and as failed only once it has recorded a failure or 30 minutes have passed. A failed result says whether starting it again from this connection uses another of the month's Diagnostics. Fits "is it ready yet?" at any point in the conversation.
name: get_run_status
title: Get a Diagnostic run's status
